sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jungle Runner is a simple yet challenging game that requires players to navigate through a dense jungle, avoiding obstacles and enemies while collecting gems to upgrade their character. The gameplay is straightforward, with players using their mouse to jump and slide through the jungle. Clicking on the mouse button will make your character jump, while swiping right will make them slide. Swiping down will make your character drop, allowing you to avoid certain obstacles or enemies. The game also features a roll move, which can be used to navigate through tight spaces or avoid enemies. Players can also jump on top of enemies to defeat them, adding a touch of strategy to the gameplay.

One of the things that sets Jungle Runner apart from other running games is its emphasis on timing and reflexes. Players need to time their jumps and slides perfectly to avoid obstacles and enemies, making the game challenging and rewarding at the same time. The game also features a variety of obstacles and enemies, each with its own unique behavior and pattern, adding to the challenge and complexity of the gameplay.

In terms of upgrades, players can spend their gems to buy powerful upgrades that will help them progress through the game.
